mechanism: Additive vasodilatory and hypotensive effects due to tadalafil's phosphodiesterase-5 inhibition combined with guanfacine's alpha-2 adrenergic agonist activity, increasing risk of syncope and severe hypotension.
action: Use with caution and monitor blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustment of guanfacine or alternative antihypertensive; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and symptoms of hypotension.
